S04 E06 — Pups Save Jake's Cake; Pups Save a Wild Ride
Ryder and the pups must help get a surprise birthday cake up to Jake's cabin; the PAW Patrol must come to the rescue when Alex and Daring Danny X snowboard toward Risky Ridge.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S03 E04 — Pups Save Alex's Mini-Patrol; Pups Save a Lost Tooth
Alex sets up his own mini-patrol, recruiting Chickaletta, Cali, Turtle, and Bunny; Alex loses his first tooth and then misplaces it.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S02 E26 — Pups Bark With Dinosaurs
The pups must catch three baby pterodactyls after they hatch from fossilized eggs unearthed on an excavation dig.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E24 — Pups Save Francois the Penguin; Pups Save Daring Danny's Hippo
Francois and a baby penguin get caught on the other side of a crevasse; Daring Danny wants a cool pet of his own.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S06 E25 — Ultimate Rescue: Pups Save the Opening Ceremonies; Ultimate Rescue: Pups Save the Adventure Bay Games
Marshall leads the pups when an underground fire threatens the opening ceremonies in this Ultimate Fire Rescue; Chase and his police-pups must find the missing medals to save the Adventure Bay Games in this Ultimate Police Rescue.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S02 E14 — Pups Save an Elephant Family; Pups and the Mischievous Kittens
While on a safari, the pups must reunite and rescue an elephant family; the Kitten Catastrophe Crew arrives in Adventure Bay and makes a mess.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S03 E11 — Good Morning, Mr. Grumpfish!
The children try to teach Mr. Grumpfish about their favorite things when he is their substitute teacher.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S03 E26 — A Dolphin Is a Guppy's Best Friend!
Molly, Gil and the Guppies must lead a baby dolphin named Buddy to the surprise birthday party his pod is throwing for him.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S02 E09 — Humunga-Truck!
The Guppies learn about different types of trucks while on their way to the Truck Show.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S03 E15 — The Bubble Bee-athalon!
The Guppies must work together to turn nectar into honey for the queen bee's tea time.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E19 — The Fastest Feather in the Race!
It's Team Flightless versus cocky Amelia the peregrine falcon; though Penguin Nonny, Ostrich Oona, and Kiwi Goby can't fly, these birds of a feather flock together; teamwork must be enough for them to win the race.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S04 E09 — Sheep Doggy!
Molly and Gil meet Farmer Joe and all the cool barnyard animals on his farm; when Farmer Joe's cute baby lamb wanders off during a big swirling popcorn storm, Bubble Puppy has to become a sheepdog and herd her back to safety!

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S04 E02 — Costume Boxing!
Molly performs in the quick-change dress-up match during Fashion Week in Bubbletucky and ends up on the cover of a fashion magazine.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S03 E22 — The Running of the Bullfrogs!
Gil and Goby bring a tadpole to school to watch him grow into a frog.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E26 — See You Later Alligator!
Chicken Farmers Deema and Goby discover an unusual egg on their farm one morning, and set off on a bayou river adventure to find the egg's mama.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E24 — Race to the Oasis!
Ice cream sellers Molly and Gil are trying to deliver ice cream to a water park on the other side of a hot desert before it melts and without getting caught by the Rattlers.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S03 E02 — The Police Cop-etition!
Officer Miranda teaches Gil and the other children how police officers use laws to keep people safe.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S01 E11 — The Legend of Pinkfoot!
The Guppies hear a spooky legend while on a camping trip.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S03 E05 — The Wizard of Oz-tralia!
A nature show host teaches the Guppies about Australian animals.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S02 E17 — Only the Sphinx Nose!
The Guppies go on an adventure in Ancient Egypt to find the Sphinx's missing nose.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Mandy Mouse's Birthday; Poems; Looking for Things; Please and Thank You; The Library
Mandy Mouse makes a birthday visit to a cheese theme park; Madame Gazelle introduces the children to poetry; Daddy Pig suggests that Peppa and George play a game.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Desert Island; Going Boating; The Little Boat; The Sand Pit; The Aquarium
Grandpa Pig and Grampy Rabbit are stranded on a desert island; everyone goes boating at the lake; Daddy Pig is left behind; Peppa and her friends build a desert island in the sandpit; Peppa takes Goldie to the aquarium.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
My Cousin Chloe; Shopping; At the Beach; Secrets; The Museum
Peppa's cousin comes to visit; the family goes to the supermarket; Peppa and George enjoy the beach; Mummy Pig makes Peppa a special box; Peppa and her family visit the museum.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Run Daddy Run; Coach Peppa; Marathon; Grownup Playground; Duck Race
Daddy Pig applies to the London Marathon; Peppa and George help Daddy Pig train for the marathon; Daddy Pig runs the London Marathon; Grampy Rabbit gives Peppa a tour around an exercise park.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S14 E03 — Pups Save a Splashy Bottom; Pups Save a Daring Tour Guide
The Pups are on the case when mechanical issues occur at the new water park, Splashy Bottom; the Pups have to save ancient relics when hijinks ensue at Danny's new job at the Museum.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S13 E01 — Pups Solve a Snap-N-Wrap Problem; Pups Save Helga and the Dingers
Before Chickaletta's play date with Baby Yukiko, Mayor Goodway baby-proofs the playground, wrapping everything in rubbery Snap-N-Wrap and gets stuck; Mayor Humdinger loses his voice.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S05 E05 — The Crew Builds A Cooking Store; The Crew Builds A Food Truck Zipline
When the pups need to make the new cooking store look special, Mix gets an idea to build with giant pasta noodles; Rubble and Grandpa Gravel build a giant zip line to help them win an awesome food truck race against Speed Meister and Mr. McTurtle!

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S13 E09 — Pups Save a Dino Digi and Tal; Pups Save a Dino Daredevil
Digi and Tal are visiting Dino Island to help Rex with dinosaur safety; when they take safety too far, they accidentally put the island at risk; when Daring Danny X's dino-stunt goes awry, he winds up with a grouchy Spinosaurus.

title: Deer Squad
description:
S04 E07 — Rise Of The Sub-Zero Sub; Balloon Bonanza
Baron Bite takes Sir Steel's submarine and modifies it into the Sub-Zero Sub, granting himself unrestricted movement; the team use their planet powers which animate Trick Alien's enormous balloon animals.

title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
description:
S01 E07 — Stuntmania!
The Monster Machines are eager to see Darington's stunt track, but Crusher tricks Darington, sending him far away.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S12 E03 — Pups Stop a Coconut Catapult; Pups Save Humdinger's Goose
The pups leap into action when Digi and Tal's coconut catapult goes rampant and rockets off through the jungle targeting birds and monkeys.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S14 E01 — Pups Stop the Garboni; Pups Save the Porcupine
Farmer Al's new machine, the Garboni, goes haywire, and it's up to Ryder and the Paw Patrol to stop it before it gives them the slip; the Paw Patrol have to catch a trouble-making sleepy porcupine and bring it back to the woods.

title: The Marsupilamis
description:
Golfalami / Mar-Sleepwalker
Three energetic Marsupilamis leave their jungle world for the city where mystery and excitement await as they bond with twins eager to protect their extraordinary friends.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S12 E05 — Search and Rescue: Pups Save a Snack-Snatcher
When the Adventure Bay potluck food goes missing, the Search and Rescue pups deputize the whole community to track it down.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S05 E04 — The Crew Builds A Fish Ladder / The Crew Builds A Construction Carnival
The crew constructs a ladder to help salmon bypass a dam blocking their upstream path; when a carnival cannot reach town, the pups build a Construction Carnival.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S12 E10 — Pups Save a Big Brother; Pups Save a Giant Baby
Farmer Yumi dreams about what her new baby will be like when she's bigger.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
The Sleepy Princess; Fancy Dress Party; Mister Skinnylegs; Musical Instruments; The Tooth Fairy
Daddy Pig tells a bedtime story; Peppa and George have a fancy dress party; George finds a spider; Mummy and Daddy Pig find an old box; Peppa loses a tooth.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Pedro the Cowboy; Grandpa Pig's Train to the Rescue; Spider Web; Wishing Well; Lost Keys
Peppa and her family visit a new theme park; Miss Rabbit's train breaks down; Mummy Pig finds a spider in the house; Granny Pig orders gnomes and a wishing well for her garden; Daddy Pig loses his car keys.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Blackberry Bush; Pottery; Paper Aeroplanes; Edmond Elephant's Birthday; The Biggest Muddy Puddle in the World
Peppa and her family collect blackberries; Mrs. Zebra teaches the children to make pottery; Daddy Pig's work papers are accidentally turned into paper airplanes; Edmond Elephant's birthday party; a flood turns Peppa's house into a desert island.

title: Peppa Pig
description:
Living Above the Shops; Roof Top Garden; Moving Day; Everybody Sleepover!; Cardboard Boxes
Peppa plays with Freddy Fox at his apartment; Peppa and family help everyone in the apartments make a garden; Peppa plays with Candy Cat; Peppa plays with all of her different friends in each of their apartments.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E22 — Fire Rescue: Pups Save the Flaming Flounder; Fire Rescue: Pups Make the News
Francois' pants catch on fire, sending both the Lighthouse and Cap'n Turbot's Flounder up in flames; a news crew is in town when Chickaletta accidentally causes a fire in Adventure Bay's new parkette.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S10 E22 — Pups Save a Talkative Mini Patrol; Pups Save the History of Adventure Bay
Alex dreams that his Mini Patrol animals can talk; the animals take the Bookmobile on a wild ride; Mayor Humdinger steals the ancient book.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S03 E06 — Pups Save Friendship Day
While celebrating Friendship Day, the pups must prevent Mayor Humdinger from ruining Adventure Bay's reputation as the friendliest town on the map.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E15 — Pups vs. the Robo-Ducky; Pups Save the Lost Penguin
Digi and Tal build a big Robo-Ducky that runs amok through Adventure Bay; when Mayor Goodway tries to catch a glimpse of a migrating penguin colony, her precious Chickaletta and a Baby Penguin accidentally switch places.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E09 — Air Rescue: Pups Save a Hum-stronaut
Captain Gordy and his space shuttle are blasting off from the Adventure Bay Airport with a satellite! But when Mayor Humdinger sneaks on board to snap a couple of selfies, the space shuttle blasts off with him still inside! Air Rescue pups save him.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S02 E18 — Pups Save an Adventure; Pups Save a Surprise
The PAW Patrol joins Alex and Mr. Porter at their campsite and teaches them how to safely build and extinguish a camp fire; while rescuing Chickaletta from the top of City Hall, the pups notice that it has been decorated for a big celebration.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E16 — Sea Patrol: Pups Save a Shark; Sea Patrol: Pups Save the Pier
Humdinger makes a robotic shark to scare everyone away from the beach; the pups come to the rescue when the pier has a broken support post.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S09 E05 — Pups Save a Humdinger Doll; Pups Save a Sand Sculpture Contest
The PAW Patrol must rescue Mayor Humdinger; Mayor Humdinger tries to cheat at the Adventure Bay sand sculpture contest.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S04 E07 — The Crew Builds a Giant Checkerboard; The Crew Builds a Corn Silo
Rubble and Wheeler team up to construct a solution for a mysterious mess on Farmer Zoe's farm; coach Karima is throwing Checkers Day for all the Builder Cove kids; when everyone can't play together, Rubble and Crew save the day with construction.

title: Rubble & Crew
description:
S01 E06 — The Crew Builds a Skate Park; The Crew Builds a Tunnel
The pups find out Auntie Crane is a secret skateboarding star, but while building a surprise skate park, they have to fix a cement mix mishap; Charger's favorite singer, Sierra Sparkle, is coming to town.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S11 E11 — Air Rescue: Pups vs. the Hum-Cloud; Air Rescue: Pups Stop the Mid-Air Magnet
Humdinger tries to sabotage the Air Rescue Pups' Air Show; Uncle Otis' powerful magnetic drone goes rogue and starts picking up every metal object in sight.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S05 E07 — Pups Save the Butterflies; Pups Save an Underground Chicken
Chickaletta is stuck on a runaway drone and mysterious butterflies cause chaos all around Adventure Bay; Mayor Humdinger steals the statue of Chickaletta.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S09 E03 — Cat Pack/PAW Patrol Rescue: Rocket Rescuers; Cat Pack/PAW Patrol Rescue: The Golden Lion Mask
Cat-Pack members Wild and Shade team up with the Mighty Pups to stop a runaway rocket; when the Ruff-Ruff Pack swipes a priceless golden lion mask from the museum, Shade and Wild must help the PAW Patrol to retrieve the stolen artifact.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S04 E23 — Pups Save Luke Stars; Pups Save Chicken Day
When Luke Stars gets stuck on a ledge, Ryder and Marshall rush to the rescue; Mayor Goodway's big plans for Chicken Day become threatened when the Chicken of Honor, Chickaletta, mysteriously disappears.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S08 E05 — Pups Save the Mustache; Pups Save the Funhouse
The Pups must help to find Mayor Humdinger's mustache after he accidentally shaves it off; after a carnival train gets stuck in a tunnel, it results in a mountainside funhouse-style wild ride.

title: PAW Patrol
description:
S09 E24 — Pups Save a Jukebox; Pups Save a Mayor on a Wire
Mayor Humdinger steals a jukebox so he can play an annoying song all day long, but Chase and Rubble track it down to save the records; a hungry eagle causes Mayor Goodway's tightrope walking lesson to go awry, sending her down Jake's Mountain.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S04 E01 — The Glitter Games!
Molly helps a princess-in-training with her manners, and together they become princesses in the hallowed Glitter Games.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S03 E23 — Fruit Camp!
Deema must turn over a new leaf and try broccoli if she wants to earn her broccoli badge at scout troop initiation.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S03 E06 — The Arctic Life!
Gil embarks on an icy expedition to the North Pole.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S05 E23 — Something Fishy Going On!
Police Officers Molly and Gil are tracking some mysterious lights that have been popping up around town; with the help of several nocturnal animal friends, they discover the lights aren't aliens but anglerfish.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S01 E16 — Super Shrimptennial Celebration!
The Bubble Guppies go sightseeing in the big city.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S06 E23 — Trouble in Harmony Valley!
Everyone in the Old West town of Harmony Valley loves playing music together; when noisy Billy Joe Strumlouder rides into town to sabotage their tunes, Sheriff Zooli must save the day.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S03 E03 — The Elephant Trunk-a-Dunk!
Gil and his friends attend a basketball game played by elephants.

title: Bubble Guppies
description:
S03 E07 — Puppy Love!
A veterinarian takes care of Bubble Puppy when he has a cold.
